transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my children thought I should come in. I suppose... I just feel very flat inside lately. Even when they come sit with me, or... or the sun is out on my garden. Things I usually care about. It just feels like the part of me that could be glad or comforted by it just... shut off. That's all.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It has been... about two weeks. Ever since... well. Since my husband collapsed. The paramedics were working on him right there in our kitchen.
Are you still able to enjoy things you normally like to do, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Well... like I was saying a minute ago. No. I don't. Even when my children are right there with me, or... or I'm looking out at the garden. I just feel flat. I can't seem to feel glad about any of it anymore. It just stays shut off.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in?
No. I... I don't know what else to tell you. Like I just said... no. There isn't anything. I can't find comfort in anything right now. That part of me is just... shut off.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yes. I... I believe we just went over that. I don't have any interest in them.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
I don't know if I'd call it sad. I haven't really noticed feeling that way. Just... what I said before.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure?

Yes. I... I don't know how many ways I can say it. Even when my children come to sit with me, or... or the sun is out on my garden... I just feel flat inside. It's like the part of me that could be glad or... or comforted by that... it's just shut off.
Do you feel sad?
I believe you just asked me that. I... no. I wouldn't use that word.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don't think so. I haven't been paying much attention to the scale, but... my clothes fit the same, I suppose.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish lately?
No... I don't believe so. I haven't been doing much of anything lately, so... I suppose I wouldn't really know. I just sit, mostly.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I haven't really done anything to feel guilty about. So, no.
Do you feel hopeless about the future?
Not really... I haven't been looking that far ahead. I just... I don't really think about what's coming next, so no. I suppose not.
Have you been having thoughts about death lately?
No... I haven't. I don't really let my mind go there. I just... keep things quiet, like I said. So, no.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions?

Well... I suppose so. I used to plan my own meals and keep my calendar straight just fine. But lately... I'll just stare at a grocery list, or the schedule for the senior center, and my mind just goes blank. I can't seem to figure it out. My daughter has had to start helping me decide on things. Just... simple things.
How many hours of the day do you feel this flatness inside?

I don't know... all of them, I suppose. It doesn't really lift. Even when my children come to sit with me, or... or the sun is shining on my garden. I still just feel flat inside. It's like... the part of me that could be glad, or... or comforted by those things... it just shut off.
Do you feel like this flatness inside is interfering with your daily life?

I suppose it is... yes. I haven't been going to the senior center at all. I mostly just stay in the house now. Like I mentioned, my daughter has had to step in for the calendar and the meals... and the errands, too. I don't really even go into the kitchen anymore, unless... unless someone is in there with me. I just stay put.
Have you had more than two weeks where you felt this flatness inside nearly every day?

Well... yes, I suppose it's been about that long. Two weeks... ever since... ever since my husband collapsed. Right there in the kitchen. The paramedics were... they were working on him right there on the floor. It's been since then.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite since your husband collapsed?
I haven't really... I don't know. I suppose I haven't paid much attention to it. My daughter just puts the food in front of me now, so... I eat what she gives me, I guess.
Do you feel sad when you think about your husband?
I don't... I don't really know. I just feel... empty, mostly. I try not to think about it too much.
Do you think this flatness inside you is mild or severe?
I... I wouldn't really know how to measure it. It's just... it's just all there is right now. I don't know.
